status: Category colours confirmed by user; chart idiom remains under discussion
colour_meaning: Editorial product-group identity, inherited from the accepted Chapter 1; not year, employment change, or production/import status

groups.scope_note: The Chapter 2 selection currently excludes ANZSIC 1912 because its employment cannot be isolated to plastic tableware. Group totals therefore refer to selected furniture and whiteware industries.

accessibility: Use direct group and industry labels alongside colour. Use arrows, dates, shapes or line styles for chronology; retain group colour identity.
pictogram_status: Candidate for group-level overview. Prefer whole neutral person icons, one fixed unit, explicit rounding and original numeric labels. Do not equate employment with factory-floor workers.
